_readme: portal.v1 verb catalog. CONTENT per mChatAI RULE #1 — the app binary carries only a frozen minimal fallback. Edit here, then run the invalidateMchataisourceCaches (local edits) or refreshMchataisourceCache (committed) tunnel command; no rebuild needed. Served to agents by the portalManifest tunnel command.
versionPolicy: portalVersion is a breaking-change counter: it increments only when an existing verb's name, required params, or response shape changes incompatibly. featureLevel increments on purely additive changes (new verbs, new optional params). Clients should refuse to run against a higher portalVersion than they understand, and may use featureLevel to detect optional capabilities.

verbs.name: portalManifest
verbs.summary: Discover the portal contract: version, this build's lane, and every verb with its parameters and examples. Call this first.
verbs.notes: Pass a verb name to get just that entry. Available in every build lane that serves the tunnel.

verbs.name: portalValidate
verbs.summary: Check a payload without executing it: verifies the command is known, available in this build lane, and has its required parameters.
verbs.notes: The dry-run verb. Never dispatches the inner payload.

verbs.name: runWizard
verbs.summary: Build a new artifact from a natural-language goal. The main workhorse: routes to a coding CLI for anything off-catalog.
verbs.notes: Slow (minutes). Returns a sessionID; poll diagSessionState rather than re-running. One wizard run at a time.

verbs.name: continueWizard
verbs.summary: Send a follow-up turn to an existing wizard session (iterate, refine, fix).

example.message: make the keyboard bigger and add a dark theme

verbs.name: diagSessionState
verbs.summary: Ground truth for a session: phase, in-flight registration, held batons, settled state. This is how you ask the app what it is doing.
verbs.notes: Omit sessionID for the active session. Safe to poll.

verbs.name: typeFollowUp
verbs.summary: Follow up on an INSTALLED artifact through the app's normal typed-follow-up path (in-place versioning, snapshot protection).
verbs.notes: Prefer this over hand-editing installed files: versions land in place and regressions are gated.

verbs.name: diagRenderProbe
verbs.summary: Render gate for an installed artifact: loads it in a real WKWebView and reports whether it renders.
verbs.notes: Keyed by miniAppID, NOT sessionID. Known quirk: the DOM-shape heuristic can flag deliberately minimal apps as sparse.

verbs.name: listSkills
verbs.summary: Enumerate every registered skill with its risk level and worker profiles.

verbs.name: runSkill
verbs.summary: Execute one skill directly with a config dictionary.

verbs.name: listPipelines
verbs.summary: Enumerate available pipelines (templates and saved).

verbs.name: runPipeline
verbs.summary: Run a pipeline end to end by name.
verbs.notes: Saved snapshots shadow catalog templates of the same name; purgeSavedPipeline clears a stale one.

verbs.name: runAgent
verbs.summary: Run the agent loop against an input for a bounded number of turns.

verbs.name: refreshMchataisourceCache
verbs.summary: Pull mchatai-source and invalidate every content cache. Use after committed+pushed content edits.
verbs.notes: Also auto-installs source JS skills. Does a git pull --ff-only; uncommitted local edits are NOT picked up by this verb.

verbs.name: invalidateMchataisourceCaches
verbs.summary: Invalidate content caches without pulling. Use when iterating on UNCOMMITTED local content edits.

verbs.name: composeMusic
verbs.summary: Compose music from a natural-language brief in LoopStar and return a portable asset handle. The producing half of the cross-applet handoff.

example.brief: noir jazz, 92bpm, 8-bar intro then a 16-bar A section, brushed kit, upright bass
example.title: noir-theme

verbs.notes: SLOW — the brief goes through a real LLM round trip in LoopStar's chat path, then an offline render. Budget minutes. Runs on the HEADLESS diagnostic conductor, so it never touches the user's open session. Set existingArrangementOnly=true to skip the LLM and export whatever arrangement is already loaded. The returned WAV is probed for duration and peak before it is registered: a silent or truncated render fails the verb rather than returning a handle to nothing.

verbs.name: attachMusic
verbs.summary: Attach a composed audio asset to a ToonStudio project as a music bed. The consuming half of the handoff.
verbs.notes: Copies the audio INTO the project directory, because ToonProject.audioFile is relative to it and a project pointing outside itself stops being portable when duplicated or published. Attaches as a per-scene music CUE, never the project narration track — that slot holds mixed dialogue and overwriting it would silently delete voice work. Scenes that already have music are left alone; the response says how many were touched.

verbs.name: portalAssets
verbs.summary: List, resolve or sweep cross-applet asset handles. Read-only; available in every build lane.
verbs.notes: An assetID is the ONLY thing that crosses the CLI boundary — absolute container paths never leave the app, because they differ per build lane and are frequently unreadable by the calling agent. `verified` is tri-state: true, false, or null for 'not yet checked', which is materially different from 'checked and failed'. action=sweep drops index entries whose file has vanished; a handle that resolves to nothing is worse than a missing one, because an agent will pass it downstream and fail two steps later.

verbs.name: portalApplets
verbs.summary: What each applet can DO: its AI actions with titles, plain-English descriptions, how each runs, and what it requires. Ask this before assuming an applet's capabilities.
verbs.notes: Sourced from AppletAIActionCatalog. Covers the applets that declare AI actions; applets driven by diag commands (LoopStar, MapGuide) are not listed here yet - see docs/APPLET_VERB_SCOPING.md.

verbs.name: portalExtensionPoints
verbs.summary: Which applet consumes which mchatai-source content, with an exemplar file to imitate, the reload verb, and how to verify.
verbs.notes: Documentation, not a gate: unlisted surfaces are still extendable.

verbs.name: applet
verbs.summary: Act on an applet. Implemented verb: 'place' - put content INTO an applet (a report into AIWrite, an episode into PodcastCreator). Returns the created entity plus a deep link that opens it.
verbs.notes: PREFER args.text over args.path - the app is sandboxed and cannot read files outside its container. Full verb roadmap: docs/APPLET_VERB_SCOPING.md.
